_about: Envelope design values per U-value set (W/m2.K). Code maximum values are used as design values when the actual wall/roof build-up is unknown - log this and ask for the real build-up. 'project_override' in project.json wins over these.
_status: Compiled from the named codes for preliminary design; values are prescriptive maxima. VERIFY against the adopted edition and climate zone.

SBC602.source: SBC 602 (2018) residential prescriptive envelope - climate zone 1/2 (verify zone for city)

GCC.source: Dubai Green Building Regulations §501 (typical GCC values)

UK_PartL.source: Approved Document L 2021 Vol.1 Table 4.1 limiting values

IECC_CZ2.source: IECC 2021 Table R402.1.2 climate zone 2 (U-0.084 wall, U-0.026 ceiling, U-0.40 fenestration)
